integrity: The analytic proof covers every permitted cycle and frequency. Reproducible numerical computations are finite corroboration, not proof of the infinite statement; bibliographic searches are not novelty certification.
scientific_limitations: Real scalar unit-edge finite cycles; single real harmonic pair or alternating harmonic only; no assertion for weighted cycles, several harmonic pairs, or infinite cycles. Equivalent results in unindexed older approximation-theory literature remain possible.
title: Sharp harmonic projection constants on finite metric cycles
